description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Canfield Scientific is hiring a Mobile Applications Engineer to support its medical mobile app suite and develop automated quality-control tools. The role focuses on usability and hardware testing, automated and manual test development, defect communication, and recommendations to improve app quality and user experience.
Mobile Applications Engineer testing mobile apps and integrated hardware, building automated test suites, and validating usability and performance

Responsibilities:
• The ideal candidate will perform thorough mobile application usability tests and develop a scalable automated test suite to leverage against our offerings
• The candidate will focus on ensuring that mobile applications are performing at a high level and that the user experience is the best in class
• In addition to usability testing, the candidate is required to learn about the competitive landscape in which each of our apps are available and ensure that our apps exceed them by making recommendations to the development team where appropriate
• In this role, the candidate is expected to contribute to the automation testing effort and write unit tests
• Carry out all aspects of mobile device and integrated hardware testing
• Validate that both software and hardware perform to established guidelines
• Work collectively with team members to solve defects and suggest improvements
• Create and execute automated programs and manual test scripts where appropriate for regression, installation, and performance/stress testing
• Monitor and communicate with developers any defects that arise when completing manual or automation testing

Requirements:
• The ideal candidate must be incredibly detail oriented to be successful in this position
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or technology
• Development experience leveraging services architectures
• Proficient with Microsoft Office

Preferred:
• Knowledge of one or more of the following - Swift, Objective-C, JavaScript, Python
• Experience with source code repository tools like Git
• Experience testing peripheral devices, graphics/imaging software

Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or technology
• Development experience leveraging services architectures

• Experience with source code repository tools like Git
• Experience testing peripheral devices, graphics/imaging software

Pay: $65K/yr - $85K/yr
